service.ar: معادلة شهادة الصف الثاني عشر داخل الدولة
service.ur: گریڈ 12 سرٹیفکیٹ کی مساوات (یو اے ای کے اسکول)

about: Get a Grade 12 certificate from a foreign-curriculum school in the UAE recognised as equivalent.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Grade 12 certificate equivalency (UAE schools). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Certificate must come from a foreign-curriculum general education institute in the UAE
Muslim students must have studied Islamic Studies and Arab students Arabic in the last three years
Distance-learning, open-school and non-aligned study is not equalised
documents: Graduation certificate and transcripts for the last 3 years
Transcripts attested by the local education regulator (ADEK, KHDA, SPEA, RAK Knowledge or MOE)
Legal translation if not in Arabic or English
Extra documents depending on the curriculum studied
PDF only, up to 5 MB per file
timing: Missing documents must be supplied within 7 days or the application is closed
channels: MOE website or mobile app, sign in with UAE PASS
